SELECT id, summary, topics, importance, best_url, best_source, best_tier, best_published_at, source_count, created_at, updated_at, headline, description, emojis, final_score, edited_at, main_topic, topic_score, scored_at FROM stories WHERE updated_at >= ? AND merged_into IS NULL AND importance >= ? ORDER BY importance DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, summary, headline, description, emojis, best_url, best_source, importance, final_score, topic_score,
       topics, main_topic, updated_at, dup_group, tr_headline, tr_description
FROM (
  SELECT s.*, coalesce(s.final_score, s.importance - ?6) AS g,
         CASE WHEN s.main_topic GLOB 'c[0-9]*' THEN max(coalesce(s.topic_score, s.final_score), s.final_score)
              ELSE s.final_score + min(max(coalesce(s.topic_score, s.final_score) - s.final_score, 0),
                                       coalesce(json_extract(?8, '$.' || s.main_topic), 10)) END AS t,
         s.main_topic IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?2) u) AS followed,
         tr.headline AS tr_headline, tr.description AS tr_description
  FROM stories s
  LEFT JOIN story_translations tr ON tr.story_id = s.id AND tr.lang = ?10 AND tr.ok = 1
       AND tr.src = coalesce(s.headline, s.summary) || char(10) || coalesce(s.description, '')
  WHERE (max(s.updated_at, coalesce(s.scored_at, 0)) >= ?3
         OR (max(s.updated_at, coalesce(s.scored_at, 0)) >= ?11
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digest_holds h WHERE h.user_id = ?1 AND h.story_id = s.id)))
    AND s.merged_into IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.topics) x WHERE x.value IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?2) u))
    AND NOT (coalesce(s.main_topic, '') IN (SELECT m.value FROM json_each(?12) m)
             AND coalesce(s.main_topic, '') NOT IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?2) u))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sent x WHERE x.user_id = ?1 AND x.story_id = s.id)
)
WHERE g >= ?5 OR (followed AND t >= ?7 AND (?9 = 0 OR t > final_score OR main_topic GLOB 'c[0-9]*'))
ORDER BY max(g, CASE WHEN followed THEN coalesce(t, 0) ELSE 0 END) DESC, g DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT ?4

SELECT id, summary, headline, description, g FROM (
  SELECT s.*, coalesce(s.final_score, s.importance - ?2) AS g,
         CASE WHEN s.main_topic GLOB 'c[0-9]*' THEN max(coalesce(s.topic_score, s.final_score), s.final_score)
              ELSE s.final_score + min(max(coalesce(s.topic_score, s.final_score) - s.final_score, 0),
                                       coalesce(json_extract(?3, '$.' || s.main_topic), 10)) END AS t
  FROM stories s
  WHERE max(s.updated_at, coalesce(s.scored_at, 0)) >= ?1
    AND s.merged_into IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.topics) x WHERE x.value IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?7) u))
    AND NOT (coalesce(s.main_topic, '') IN (SELECT m.value FROM json_each(?8) m)
             AND coalesce(s.main_topic, '') NOT IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?7) u))
)
WHERE g >= ?4 OR (main_topic IN (SELECT u.value FROM json_each(?7) u)
                  AND t >= CASE WHEN main_topic GLOB 'c[0-9]*' THEN ?9 ELSE ?5 END
                  AND (?6 = 0 OR t > final_score OR main_topic GLOB 'c[0-9]*'))
ORDER BY g DESC, id DESC

SELECT model, count(*) AS calls,
       sum(CASE WHEN code = 429 OR (code IS NULL AND error LIKE '%HTTP 429%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r429,
       sum(CASE WHEN at >= ?2 AND (code = 429 OR (code IS NULL AND error LIKE '%HTTP 429%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent429
FROM ai_calls WHERE at >= ?1 GROUP BY model

SELECT provider, model, coalesce(kind, 'batch') AS kind,
  sum(at >= ?1) AS calls_24h, sum(CASE WHEN at >= ?1 THEN ok ELSE 0 END) AS ok_24h,
  sum(CASE WHEN at >= ?1 THEN input_tokens ELSE 0 END) AS in_24h,
  sum(CASE WHEN at >= ?1 THEN output_tokens ELSE 0 END) AS out_24h,
  count(*) AS calls_7d, sum(ok) AS ok_7d, sum(input_tokens) AS in_7d, sum(output_tokens) AS out_7d
FROM ai_calls WHERE at >= ?2 GROUP BY provider, model, coalesce(kind, 'batch') ORDER BY calls_7d DESC

SELECT count(*) AS runs,
  sum(status IN ('error', 'ai_failed')) AS failed, sum(status = 'partial') AS partial,
  sum(provider IS NOT NULL AND provider <> 'gemini') AS fallback_runs,
  sum(items_fetched) AS items_fetched, sum(items_new) AS items_new,
  sum(stories_created) AS stories_created, sum(stories_merged) AS stories_merged,
  sum(items_dropped) AS items_dropped, sum(ai_calls) AS ai_calls,
  sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  sum(editor_status = 'ok') AS editor_ok, sum(editor_status = 'failed') AS editor_failed,
  sum(editor_merged) AS editor_merged
FROM job_runs WHERE started_at >= ?1

SELECT t.id, t.tag, t.names, t.emoji, t.definition, t.queries, t.boost_max, t.searched_at, t.keywords,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM custom_follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id
        WHERE f.topic_id = t.id AND f.enabled = 1 AND u.paused = 0 AND u.blocked = 0) AS active
FROM custom_topics t WHERE t.tag IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id
